subject: Hosted API: commit kicker + rate granularity migration for ParcelNest renewal
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@parcelnest.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API: commit kicker + rate granularity migration for ParcelNest renewal

Hi Alex,

Happy Monday — as we approach your Sept renewal, I wanted to propose a conservative path to expand ParcelNest's hosted commit while protecting you from short-term burst risk. After reviewing the last 3 months, we see predictable growth in peak windows; a small change to the monthly committed tokens plus finer-grained rate tiers will lower unit costs and reduce soft-throttle events.

Proposal (high level):
- Increase monthly committed tokens by 18% (move from 2.5M -> 2.95M)
- Introduce a three-band rate granularity (base / peak / burst) to reduce overage spikes during checkout surges
- Add a one-time commit kicker credit that smooths the first 2 billing cycles (applied as usage credit)

Benefits for ParcelNest: predictable per-token pricing, less operational risk during promotional spikes, and immediate cost smoothing via the kicker. I attached a short MAP and a draft SLA with the proposed rate bands.

Would you be open to a 20–30 minute call this week to walk through numbers and timeline? If yes, I can loop in Marissa for onboarding ops and Laura for CS readiness.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: ParcelNest_SLA_2025-07.pdf (draft, 2 pages)
Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_ParcelNest.xlsx (MAP, worksheets: timeline / contacts / tasks)

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@parcelnest.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@parcelnest.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API: commit kicker + rate granularity migration for ParcelNest renewal

Jonas,

Thanks for the outline — this looks promising. A few clarifying Qs before we schedule: 
1) How will the three-band rate apply to streaming vs. non-streaming calls? We rely on streaming for our tracking pipeline and want consistent headroom.
2) Does the commit kicker require a term extension to 15 months, or can it be applied to our existing 12-month cadence?
3) Quick ask from procurement: can you confirm whether audit logs for request traces will be retained 90 days under the new plan (we have an internal control we must meet).

If answers are straightforward we can do the call with our billing lead tomorrow afternoon (2–3pm PT).

Best,
Alex

Marissa: can you prepare a short cost delta table (current vs proposed bands) with separate rows for streaming and non-streaming token units? Highlight the effective unit cost assuming 85% utilization.

Karthik: confirm whether the kicker requires a term change. My read from legal/finance (previously) was that a one-time credit can be applied on renewal invoice without forcing 15 months, but I want your sign-off.

Laura: procurement is asking about audit log retention — can you confirm default retention for hosted customers and any add-on options? If 90 days is not default, what's the delta cost and ETA to enable?

My plan: answer Alex's questions succinctly, propose the 2–3pm PT slot for tomorrow, and include an updated MAP + SLA PDF showing the three-band bands and the kicker amortization across cycles.

Thanks — Jonas

Alex / ParcelNest team — great to speak earlier. Per our call, summary and next steps: 

Summary answers to your Qs:
- Rate band application: streaming calls will be billed from the same three-band table but we will apply a streaming multiplier of 1.05x to account for persistent connections. Effect: streaming headroom cost remains predictable while keeping base-unit parity.
- Kicker & term: the commit kicker is a one-time usage credit applied across the first two invoices after renewal; it does NOT require changing your core term from 12 months. We can document this in the SLA.
- Audit logs: hosted default retention is 30 days. 90-day retention is available as an add-on; estimated incremental cost ~ $1,200/month and we can enable it within 5 business days post-signature.

What I attached: updated MAP (Mutual_Action_Plan_ParcelNest.xlsx) with tasks, owners and dates; updated SLA (ParcelNest_SLA_2025-07.pdf) with the three-band tables and kicker line item.

Proposed commercial:
- New committed monthly tokens: 2,950,000
- Rate bands (base / peak / burst): see attached table in SLA
- One-time kicker credit: equivalent to 10% of the first-month committed spend, applied as invoice credit split across the first 2 invoices
- DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?session=abc123-parcelnest (expires in 7 days)

Next steps: 
1) Alex / procurement to confirm approval to sign by Fri, 4 Jul 2025 so we can make the change effective from the 1st of next month.
2) Marissa and Laura to schedule onboarding and enable 90-day retention if ParcelNest opts in.
3) I will send the DocuSign packet and final invoice schedule once we get verbal approval.

Alex — can you confirm if procurement wants the 90-day retention enabled? If yes we will include that in the final DocuSign packet.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting ParcelNest the headroom they need for Q4 promos.

Best,
